title: Arkret Media Service Binding Result
description: Own-Station verified route and signing keys for the media service anchored by one joined Realm current accepted ak.component.realm.media_service.v1 typed current result. It resolves service identity, purpose and route only; it releases no media key, no backend token and no plaintext-visibility authorization.

service_signing_key.description: One accepted assertion-capable Ed25519 signing key of the anchored media service, taken from the same verified current DID Document as the route. The controller DID of verification_method equals the route did; the key verifies participant_binding and ICE config signatures without a per-token DID resolution.

public_key_b64u.description: Canonical unpadded base64url of exactly 32 Ed25519 public-key bytes. Public verification material only; it grants no media key release.

media_service_binding_request_body.description: Authenticated member request for one joined Realm. The media service identity is taken from that Realm current accepted typed current result; caller-supplied service ids, DIDs, base URLs, candidate origins and method evidence are not accepted.

media_service_binding_outcome.description: Complete bounded own-Station result: the accepted anchor, its verified route projection and the signing keys that verify issued media signatures. No method history evidence, witness record, normalized DID Document, describe body or third-party attestation closure is returned. expires_at bounds route and key reuse only and is never an authorization lease.

route.description: Verified route projection of the anchored media service; service_id equals the accepted typed current result service_id and service_kind is media_service.
